capabilities: Import iCal/ICS feeds into a note
Write events as markdown tasks or wikilinks
Preserve completed imported tasks across syncs
Handle recurring, all-day, and multi-day events
Report skipped or malformed events in an error section
disambiguation: One-way only: it imports ICS feeds into the vault and does not export Obsidian tasks back to a calendar, sign in to accounts, or use CalDAV.
extras: One-way import only; no OAuth, CalDAV, or account sign-in, so feeds needing a login page or HTML calendar view are unsupported. Private iCal links act like passwords and are hidden from status/error messages. For vaults shared across devices, only one device should write calendar notes. Source ZIP releases need building; they do not include main.js.
problem: Calendar events from Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud, or other ICS feeds have to be retyped by hand to appear as tasks in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Calendar Importer pairs beautifully with the Tasks plugin.

requires.name: Calendar provider publishing an iCal/ICS feed URL (Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud, Zoho)

summary: Background importer that turns iCal/ICS calendar feeds into markdown tasks inside a managed section of a note.
